_comment: Copy to services.json to populate the console's service board.
Each entry needs an id plus at least one of: unit, port, probe_url.
unit       systemd unit to report state for (must end in .service)
probe_url  URL to GET; an OpenAI-style /v1/models body shows the model id
group      inference | agent | apps | meta   (controls sort order)
critical   true = raise an alert when it is not running
This board is read-only. The console never starts or stops anything.
